title: Mean Field Competition of Optimal Switching: The Vanishing Entropy Regularization Approach
summary: This paper studies a type of rank-based mean field game in which competing agents strategically switch among multiple effort regimes. We propose an entropy regularized auxiliary problem where the switching decisions are randomized to the control of transition probability for a continuous-time finite-state Markov chain. We first establish the existence of regularized equilibrium in this auxiliary problem.
